title: Alhambra amazing
text: Enrique was very knowledgeable he took us around the Alhambra and showed us a great restaurant for lunch after our tour. We also had some great traditional ice cream at a shop he took us to in Granada
author: pmppainting

title: TRANQUILITY.COMFORT. A CHARMING STROLL
text: When hiring a guided and personalized excursion, one desires an accompaniment that takes you through "a sea of clouds," evoking that softness, immensity, and tranquility in the development of the activity, as has been the case for us. Grateful.
author: Navigate11472600471

title: Perfect day at the Alhambra
text: David was very responsive in terms of communication - quick response times and we never had any issues. On the drive there, he was very knowlegable and told us about many of the sites we drove past. He was very accomodating and able to keep going or stop based on your needs, and he knew all the best toilet and rest spots at any given point. At Granada, Danny was a very knowlegable and enthusiastic tour guide, answering any questions we had about the architecture or history of the Alhambra. Would very highly recommend this tour to all groups, and would definitely want to try some of their other
author: David_C

title: Highly recommended
text:
From the moment of pick up at 8am to drop off back at our hotel nearly 12 hours later, this tour was excellent.  Our driver, Peter, & Alhambra guide, Noelle, couldn't have been better. Friendly, knowledgeable & courteous. 
We were so pleased we opted for a private tour. We never felt rushed as can happen in a large group.
author: Expedition738176

title: Bucket List Day
text: Our private tour of The Alhambra was fantastic. Noela, our guide, was extremely knowledgeable about the history of the site and set a pace where we could enjoy the art and architecture as well as the vistas. David, not only was our driver but also took us on a walking tour through historic Granada. He was great too! He provided a lot of background information as well as additional suggestions for our stay in Seville. We would highly recommend them as guides!
author: Cruiser19971232253

title: Amazing Alhambra.
text: Great day out visiting one of the most important sights in Spain. David our guide and driver was very informative and kept us all comfortable during the day. Our guide at the Alhambra explained the various rooms we visited. Lunch was terrific with great food and service.  Would recommend this tour to anyone looking to visit the Alhambra.
author: R7298YXrobertp

title: Amazing Trip to the Alhambra!
text: I agonized over whether to do a cheaper large group bus tour versus a small group private tour.  I'm so glad that I chose to go private with Andalucia Experiencias!  They did not disappoint.  We were picked up promptly in a comfortable Mercedes van and our driver-guide was very personable as well as knowledgeable about the landscape and towns through which we passed on our drive from Seville to Granada. title: Alhambra a must see
text:
We had an exceptional experience with our guide Peter, who provided seamless transportation from Seville to Granada while also enriching our journey with fascinating insights along the way. His knowledge of the region’s history and culture made the drive feel like an engaging storytelling session rather than just a transfer.
